answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, clawed back after a replayed submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Reaching the wharf of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the dawn until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ember of the next round.
